column1: # Custom partition table for FireBeetle 2 ESP32-S3 (16 MB flash).
# Gives the app 3 MB and LittleFS ~12.9 MB for photos + entries.json.
# At ~50 KB per JPEG (OV3660 SVGA q10)
# we cap at 30 in firmware but having headroom prevents fragmentation pain.
# To use: in Arduino IDE → Tools → Partition Scheme → "Custom".
# The IDE picks up this file automatically because it lives next to the .ino.
